_: The scars a people carries: what a filter faced badly leaves behind, as a creed or a memory the people lives under from then on. The simulation reads the key, the dials and iron; the view reads name and desc.

scars: one row per scar: key; name (how the legends say it, as the object of 'live under'); desc (what it is in the world); dials (what it does to the people's temperament: aggression, risk, greed, fear, loyalty, hunger, patience, hate; the scars with dials come first, in the order the sums are taken); iron marks the scars that stiffen a people's ways.
Every term here is a technical term: a phrase a reader who never saw this project understands or can search for, never a coinage.

scars.name: the memory of chains
scars.desc: the memory of chains: this people was owned once

scars.name: the memory of the burning sky
scars.desc: the memory of the burning sky: what the sky did once it may do again

scars.name: a fatalist creed
scars.desc: a fatalist creed: what is coming cannot be turned, and nothing is worth the trying

scars.name: iron centralism
scars.desc: iron centralism: the colonies are held by force, and the centre decides everything

scars.name: a quarantine creed
scars.desc: a quarantine creed: every stranger is a carrier, and the borders are closed

scars.name: a church that outranks the state
scars.desc: the church outranks the state: what may be thought is decided by the faith, and the sciences of doubt are closed

scars.name: a stewardship creed
scars.desc: a creed of stewardship: the world is not to be spent, and growth is a sin

scars.name: an atomic taboo
scars.desc: the atom is not split again: the survivors of an atomic war forbid the power and the weapon alike

scars.name: a prohibition on thinking machines
scars.desc: a prohibition on thinking machines, after the ones they made turned on them

scars.name: a mortality creed
scars.desc: a mortality creed: death is not to be cheated, after the long silence of a people that stopped dying

scars.name: a creed of the flesh
scars.desc: a creed of the flesh: no mind is to leave its body, after most of them nearly did

scars.name: the law that no machine may make itself
scars.desc: the law that no machine may make itself, after the swarm

scars.name: a fear of their own star
scars.desc: a fear of their own star, after they broke it

scars.name: being the ones left behind
scars.desc: being the ones left behind: the rest went elsewhere, and these are what stayed

scars.name: a cult of the signal
scars.desc: a cult of the signal: the transmitter is worshipped, and its voice comes first

scars.name: a dread of doors
scars.desc: a dread of doors: the crossing is used only in extremity

scars.name: the other voices on the line
scars.desc: the other voices on the line: the ansible was opened, and something else was speaking

scars.name: having been something else
scars.desc: having been something else: this people was remade, and remembers what it was

scars.name: a horror of the vial
scars.desc: a horror of the vial: the crafts of the plague-maker above this rung are closed
